MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Ethernet switch felt like a useful next step after my USB Ethernet adapter because it could let me connect more wired devices.",
    "The wired earbuds with a microphone and the HDMI switch connect to my earlier headset and display-cable purchases, so I can see why they might interest me, even though I would not choose them now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The keyboard, internal hard drive, backup power unit, and memory card address needs I have not expressed; owning computer accessories does not mean I currently need those upgrades.",
    "My headset purchase does not imply a need for a large speaker system or an amplifier controller, and I have no specific reason to replace my existing earbuds.",
    "The discontinued notice on the backup power unit gives me less reason to investigate an item that already feels unrelated to my current needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My computer-accessory purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in anything for a computer, rather than purchases for particular connection needs.",
    "My older headset and DVI cable purchases seem to have been stretched into interest in audio and display equipment without a clear use for those particular items."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase supports wired networking, which makes the Ethernet switch more relevant to me than unrelated computer upgrades.",
    "I buy infrequently and need a concrete reason to act; something can relate to my past purchases without being something I need now.",
    "The connection type and purpose matter: a DVI cable does not establish that I need HDMI switching, and a headset does not establish that I need room speakers."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my interest in practical connectivity, but often extended it into equipment I have no current reason to buy."
}
